text:
anya: Quick alert 1: our new sdk@2.3.1 change to package exports is breaking a couple of edge quickstarts. Vercel build log shows `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` when samples use `const RI = require('redwood-inference')`.

build-bot: CI: samples/edge-quickstart job #214 failed at bundle step. Snippet: `RollupError: Could not resolve 'redwood-inference'` then `Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: Must use import to load ES Module`.

ben: I dug in 1: the exports map only had import/require targets and no `worker` condition or explicit `/edge` subpath. Edge bundlers (esbuild/vite) sometimes resolve to the ESM branch; when legacy CJS code calls require(), Node throws.

kai: TypeScript is also unhappy: TS infers the ESM typings and downstream CJS consumers see `.default` mismatches. We don't have conditional types in package.json, so TS can't pick the right declaration.

anya: Impact: onboarding friction for new users following quickstarts (many still use require()). We should ship a minimal, low-risk patch to avoid mass churn in samples while documenting the edge path.

ben: Proposed patch (minimal): 1) add `./edge` subpath export pointing to `./dist/edge/esm/index.js`, 2) add `worker` condition pointing to same edge build, 3) add `main: ./dist/cjs/index.js` and `module: ./dist/esm/index.js` for older bundlers, 4) add conditional `types` mapping and simple runtime shim in CJS build that does `module.exports = exports.default || exports`.

kai: Also add `typesVersions` entries so older TS picks up the CJS d.ts for require-style consumers. And add two small smoke tests to CI: a CJS require run and an ESM import run, plus a vercel build for the edge sample.

anya: Sounds good. For docs: update edge quickstarts to prefer `import RI from 'redwood-inference/edge'` and keep a one-line CJS compatibility example: `const RI = require('redwood-inference').default || require('redwood-inference')`. We'll link to the changelog note.

build-bot: Issue created #4112: "hotfix: exports + types for edge compatibility" assigned to ben.

ben: I'll open the PR today with the exports patch and tests. Kai, can you add the typesVersions snippet and the CJS shim?

kai: Will do. I'll also run local `vercel dev` and `wrangler` smoke builds to verify.

anya: Thanks team 1: please tag me on the PR. Once merged we'll cut a patch release and update the quickstarts.
